stem_book: Three point objects of masses 1 kg, 2 kg & 3 kg are fixed at the vertices of a massless triangular wire frame ABC at points A, B and C respectively. Co-ordinates of A, B and C are (0, 0), (2, 0) and (1, 2) respectively (in metres) at the instant shown in figure. Find the moment of inertia (in kg-m²) of the system about the y-axis.
